title: NamedQueueCatalog
description: Versioned named-queue catalog envelope mounted at QUEUE_CATALOG_PATH for one-shot workhold apply (ensure-exists). Machine-readable companion to docs/05-operations/02-deployment.md and docs/08-examples/07-named-queue-catalog.md. Not a runtime desired-state document.

schema_version.description: Catalog envelope major version. Unsupported majors MUST fail closed before any write.

queues.description: Named Work Queues to ensure-exists. Duplicate name values fail closed. Order is apply order; mid-run failure may leave earlier creates committed.

initial_policy.description: Initial retry policy used only when the queue is created. Existing queues (any state/policy) are skipped; apply never activates a new policy version.
